paper_metadata.title: Charpy absorbed energy of ultrafine-grained Ti-6Al-4V alloy at cryogenic and elevated temperatures

evidence.quote: The dependence of the absorbed energy of ultrafine-grained (UFG) Ti-6Al-4V alloy on the test temperature is studied .
